# Publishing xml_struct does not remove its documented EWS serialization limits

The patch removes the do-not-publish documentation and a standalone test-crate dev-dependency. Its selected library hunk changes no serialization algorithm or assertion. The accepted library still documents EWS-oriented PascalCase derives, ASCII-only case conversion and no deserialization, and retains mod tests. Publication and the removed test dependency do not establish broader XML support or a test result. This imported behavior evidence does not define Thunderbird comment or manifest style.

Scope: Imported XML crate publication scope.
